title: Horizon and Vector
author: Isandro Halloran
blurb: Wendell Whitlock, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
